If you want some legitimate complaints about Windows 10, here are a couple. I tried it on a tablet. There is still no pinch-to-zoom feature for desktop or modern UI. If you want to zoom in, you need to use the Windows magnifier, which is a nightmare. You get these large boarders around the screen that you must drag a finger along to pan around. You must drag along the sides to move top to bottom and you must drag along the bottom or top of the screen to pan left and right. You can't simply point to where you want to go and these boarders limit the viewing area even more than it already is on a small screen. Compare this to the great magnification on IOS or Android.

The on-screen keyboard still does not pop up automatically in 99% of desktop programs. This is also incredibly annoying. It was like this in Windows 8.x and I expected these things to be fixed. Oddly enough, Chrome can make the keyboard pop up automatically on the tablet, but not notepad, or desktop IE, or windows freaking explorer! What was Microsoft doing for the past two years? I wish there was a way for me to go back in time and punch myself in the face before I got a Windows tablet.
